Tab bar at the top

column1: # context: description of that switch; Facebook shows the tab bar at the top of the screen on some accounts and at the bottom on others
Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom, within thumb reach, on accounts that show it at the top. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Place la barre d'onglets de Facebook en bas, à portée de pouce, sur les comptes qui l'affichent en haut. Redémarrez Facebook pour voir le changement.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the search row is the top bar with the Facebook logo, search and Messenger
Moves Facebook's tab bar to the top, under the search row, as older Facebook had it. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Place la barre d'onglets de Facebook en haut, sous la barre de recherche, comme dans les anciennes versions de Facebook. Redémarrez Facebook pour voir le changement.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, right after Tab bar at the bottom; the bar slides off the screen while you scroll the feed down
Hide the tab bar while scrolling
column2: Masquer la barre d'onglets pendant le défilement

column1: # context: description of that switch; it does nothing while the tab bar is at the top of the screen
The bottom tab bar hides as you scroll down and returns when you scroll up, for more room. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: La barre d'onglets du bas se masque quand vous faites défiler vers le bas et revient quand vous remontez, pour libérer de la place. Redémarrez Facebook pour voir le changement.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, after Hide the tab bar while scrolling; the bottom bar never slides off the screen
Keep the tab bar on screen
column2: Garder la barre d'onglets à l'écran

column1: # context: description of that switch; it greys out while Hide the tab bar while scrolling is on
The bottom tab bar stays put while you scroll, on accounts where Facebook slides it away. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: La barre d'onglets du bas reste en place pendant le défilement, sur les comptes où Facebook la fait disparaître. Redémarrez Facebook pour voir le changement.

column1: # context: switch title right after it; the bar at the top with search and Messenger never slides off the screen
Keep the top bar on screen
column2: Garder la barre du haut à l'écran

column1: # context: description of that switch
The top bar with search and Messenger stays put while you scroll down, instead of sliding away.
column2: La barre du haut avec la recherche et Messenger reste en place quand vous faites défiler vers le bas, au lieu de disparaître.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, after Keep the top bar on screen; a big screen is a tablet or the inner screen of a folding phone, and the phone layout is the one Facebook shows on a normal phone
Phone layout on big screens
column2: Disposition téléphone sur grand écran

column1: # context: description of that switch; on a big screen Facebook keeps the tab bar at the top in a wider layout, so the tab bar switches above it do nothing there

A tablet or an unfolded phone gets the layout Facebook uses on a phone, so the tab bar choices above work on the big screen too. Facebook's wider big screen layout goes away. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a big screen yet. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Une tablette ou un téléphone déplié reçoit la disposition que Facebook utilise sur téléphone, pour que les choix de barre d'onglets ci-dessus fonctionnent aussi sur grand écran. La disposition plus large de Facebook pour grand écran disparaît. Désactivée par défaut, car l'option n'a pas encore été testée sur un grand écran. Redémarrez Facebook pour voir le changement.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, after Phone layout on big screens; it makes Facebook's top bar (search and Messenger) and its tab bar partly transparent

column2: Barres transparentes

column1: # context: description of that switch; the feed is the list of posts on Home, and blurred means frosted like glass
The top bar and the tab bar turn see-through, so the feed shows through them as you scroll. On Android 12 and newer the feed behind them is blurred.
column2: La barre du haut et la barre d'onglets deviennent transparentes, et le fil apparaît à travers pendant le défilement. Sur Android 12 et versions ultérieures, le fil derrière elles est flouté.

column1: With the tab bar at the bottom, it gets round ends and sits a little smaller, just above the bottom of the screen, with a soft highlight behind the tab you're on.
column2: Quand la barre d'onglets est en bas, elle prend des bords arrondis et devient un peu plus petite, juste au-dessus du bas de l'écran, avec une légère surbrillance derrière l'onglet où vous êtes.

column1: # context: description of that switch; on some tablets Facebook's own Settings page has no Dark mode row
Keeps Facebook dark no matter its own setting. Meant for tablets where Facebook has no Dark mode switch. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Garde Facebook en mode sombre quel que soit son propre réglage. Pensé pour les tablettes où Facebook n'a pas d'option Mode sombre. Redémarrez Facebook pour voir le changement.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, shown with the AMOLED black theme; it makes cards, comments and menus pure black like the page
Black cards
column2: Cartes noires

column1: # context: description of that switch; a card is a raised panel such as a post or the Menu's profile box, near black is the dark gray the theme gives it

Cards and menus take the page's own color instead of the near black that sets them apart. Buttons and search fields keep a dark gray fill, so you can still see them. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Les cartes et les menus prennent la couleur de la page au lieu du presque noir qui les distingue. Les boutons et les champs de recherche gardent un fond gris foncé, pour que vous les voyiez toujours. Redémarrez Facebook pour voir le changement.

column1: %1$s becomes the date and time of the save, %2$s the video's number on Facebook, %3$s who posted it, %4$s their profile's number on Facebook and %5$s the day it was posted. What a save doesn't know is left out, and a name with none of these gets the date added. When the name is already in the folder, the time of the save goes on the end. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to use the default, %6$s.
column2: %1$s devient la date et l'heure de l'enregistrement, %2$s le numéro de la vidéo sur Facebook, %3$s la personne qui l'a publiée, %4$s le numéro de son profil sur Facebook et %5$s le jour de la publication. Ce qu'un enregistrement ne connaît pas est omis, et un nom sans aucun de ces éléments reçoit la date. Si le nom existe déjà dans le dossier, l'heure de l'enregistrement est ajoutée à la fin. Les caractères non valides deviennent des tirets bas. Laissez vide pour utiliser le nom par défaut, %6$s.

Stop link history in Facebook's browser
column2: Arrêter l'historique des liens dans le navigateur de Facebook

column1: # context: description of that switch; Facebook's own browser is the one built into the app
Links that open in Facebook's own browser aren't recorded for your link history or sent to Facebook as pages you visited. Applies to the next link you open.
column2: Les liens qui s'ouvrent dans le navigateur de Facebook ne sont pas enregistrés dans votre historique de liens ni envoyés à Facebook comme pages visitées. S'applique au prochain lien que vous ouvrez.

column1: Allow screenshots
column2: Autoriser les captures d'écran

column1: Lets you take screenshots and screen recordings on pages where Facebook blocks them. Reopen a page that's already open.
column2: Vous permet de faire des captures et des enregistrements d'écran sur les pages où Facebook les bloque. Rouvrez une page déjà ouverte.

column1: Block screenshot detection
column2: Bloquer la détection des captures d'écran

column1: Hide typing in chats
column2: Masquer la saisie dans les discussions

column1: Hide typing in comments
column2: Masquer la saisie dans les commentaires

column1: People you chat with in Facebook's own chats can't see when you're typing. Messages send as usual.
column2: Les personnes avec qui vous discutez dans les discussions de Facebook ne voient pas quand vous écrivez. Les messages s'envoient normalement.

column1: People looking at a post don't see that you're writing a comment.
column2: Les personnes qui regardent une publication ne voient pas que vous écrivez un commentaire.

column1: Hide read receipts
column2: Masquer les confirmations de lecture

column1: People you chat with in Facebook's own chats can't see that you've read their messages. The chat can stay unread on this phone.
column2: Les personnes avec qui vous discutez dans les discussions de Facebook ne voient pas que vous avez lu leurs messages. La discussion peut rester non lue sur ce téléphone.

column1: Facebook can't tell when you take a screenshot or record your screen, so it can't react.
column2: Facebook ne sait pas quand vous faites une capture d'écran ou enregistrez votre écran, il ne peut donc pas réagir.

column1: Stops sending Facebook your list of watched reels, and where you stopped in each video and how long you watched it. Facebook ranks your feed with these, so videos you've watched may come back.
column2: Arrête l'envoi à Facebook de la liste des reels vus, de l'endroit où vous vous êtes arrêté dans chaque vidéo et de la durée de visionnage. Facebook classe votre fil avec ces données, les vidéos déjà vues peuvent donc revenir.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the Reels tab shows the most recently posted reels before older ones
Newest reels first
column2: Reels les plus récents d'abord

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "loaded" means the reels the app has already downloaded in the background, "placed" means reels already lined up as the next ones
# context: what stays in while Hushfacebook is paused, shown before the patch's name in brackets; the patch raises the app's version number so Google Play never offers an update
Meta's apps can install beside this one
column2: Les applis de Meta peuvent s'installer à côté de celle-ci

column1: Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace can install next to this Facebook. Their shared permissions no longer clash.
column2: Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite et Workplace peuvent s'installer à côté de ce Facebook. Leurs autorisations partagées n'entrent plus en conflit.

column1: # context: settings section heading for the Open on a chosen tab rows
Opening Facebook
column2: Ouverture de Facebook

column1: # context: switch title; the list below it picks the tab
Open on a chosen tab
column2: Ouvrir sur un onglet choisi

column1: Choose where Facebook opens from its icon. Notifications and links still open their destination.
column2: Choisissez où Facebook s'ouvre depuis son icône. Les notifications et les liens ouvrent toujours leur destination.

column1: # context: title of the list of tabs Facebook can open on
Tab to open on
column2: Onglet d'ouverture

column1: # context: the names of Facebook's own tabs, as its tab bar shows them
Home
column2: Accueil

column1: Feeds
column2: Fils

column1: Video
column2: Vidéo

column1: Friends
column2: Amis

column1: Marketplace
column2: Marketplace

column1: # context: a tab's name, as Facebook's tab bar shows it; the list of tabs Facebook can open on
Events
column2: Évènements

column1: Notifications
column2: Notifications

column1: Menu
column2: Menu

column1: # context: summary of the tab list; %1$s is one of the tab names above
Facebook opens on %1$s. If your tab bar doesn't have it, Facebook opens on Home.
column2: Facebook s'ouvre sur %1$s. Si votre barre d'onglets ne l'a pas, Facebook s'ouvre sur l'Accueil.

column1: # context: summary of the tab list when Feeds is picked; off the tab bar, Feeds opens as its own page over Home
Facebook opens on Feeds. If your tab bar doesn't have it, the Feeds page opens over Home.
column2: Facebook s'ouvre sur Fils. Si votre barre d'onglets ne l'a pas, la page Fils s'ouvre par-dessus l'Accueil.

column1: # context: a sentence in the settings import preview and its toast; %1$s is a tab name
With %1$s on, Facebook will open on %2$s.
column2: Avec %1$s activé, Facebook s'ouvrira sur %2$s.

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook; Following is Facebook's feed of the friends, Pages and groups you follow, and Home is the tab
Following feed on Home
column2: Fil Abonnements sur l'Accueil

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the ranked feed is the one Facebook orders for you, and the Feeds tab has its own filters
Home shows the newest posts from friends, groups and Pages you follow, like All in the Feeds tab, or the filter you pick below. The Feeds tab's filters don't change.
column2: L'Accueil affiche les publications les plus récentes des amis, groupes et Pages que vous suivez, comme Tout dans l'onglet Fils, ou le filtre que vous choisissez ci-dessous. Les filtres de l'onglet Fils ne changent pas.

column1: Jump to a section
column2: Aller à une section

column1: Go straight to one group of settings. Back returns to where you were.
column2: Allez directement à un groupe de paramètres. Retour vous ramène où vous étiez.

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads; on, every video save keeps to formats other apps accept
Save videos other apps can open
column2: Enregistrer des vidéos lisibles par d'autres applis

column1: # context: summary of that switch; WhatsApp is a name and stays as it is, and saves are the videos the user saved to the phone
Fixes saved videos that play without sound in WhatsApp, video editors such as CapCut and InShot, or some galleries and players. May lower quality.
column2: Corrige les vidéos enregistrées qui se lisent sans son dans WhatsApp, dans les éditeurs vidéo comme CapCut et InShot, ou dans certaines galeries et certains lecteurs. Peut réduire la qualité.

column1: # context: title of a switch under Downloads; convert means re-encoding the video on the phone
Convert to keep the full size
column2: Convertir pour garder la taille d'origine

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Save videos other apps can open is the switch above it, VP9, AV1 and H.264 are video formats and stay as they are

With Save videos other apps can open on, a full size video Facebook only has as VP9 or AV1 is converted to H.264 on your phone instead of saved smaller. Slower, and videos over 10 minutes stay smaller.
column2: Avec Enregistrer des vidéos lisibles par d'autres applis activé, une vidéo en taille d'origine que Facebook n'a qu'en VP9 ou AV1 est convertie en H.264 sur votre téléphone au lieu d'être enregistrée plus petite. C'est plus lent, et les vidéos de plus de 10 minutes restent plus petites.

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads; on, a save shows no message when it starts, finishes or is canceled
Quiet saves
column2: Enregistrements discrets

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a toast is Android's short message at the bottom of the screen
No toast when a save starts, finishes or is canceled. A save that fails still says why.
column2: Aucun message quand un enregistrement commence, se termine ou est annulé. Un enregistrement qui échoue indique toujours pourquoi.

column1: # context: section title for the Chats settings, named like Facebook's own Chats screen
Chats
column2: Discussions

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; the card is Facebook's own "Get the Messenger app" card
Hide the Get Messenger card
column2: Masquer la carte Obtenir Messenger

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Messenger is the app's name and stays as it is
Hides the card at the top of Chats that asks you to get Messenger, once Messenger is installed. Without Messenger, the card stays.
column2: Masque la carte en haut de Discussions qui vous invite à obtenir Messenger, une fois Messenger installé. Sans Messenger, la carte reste.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; the notes and active now row is the row of friends' notes and who's active above the chat list in Chats inside Facebook
Hide the notes and active now row
column2: Masquer la rangée des notes et des personnes actives

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Removes the row above your chats that shows friends' notes and who's active. Your own note tile may go too. Your chats stay.
column2: Retire la rangée au-dessus de vos discussions qui montre les notes des amis et qui est actif. Votre propre note peut disparaître aussi. Vos discussions restent.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; promotions are the banners Facebook puts at the top of the chat list
Hide chat list promotions
column2: Masquer les promotions de la liste des discussions

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Hides the banners at the top of Chats, like the one asking you to turn on notifications.
column2: Masque les bannières en haut de Discussions, comme celle qui vous invite à activer les notifications.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name; the button sits beside the search box at the top of Chats and on Chats' search screen
Hide the Meta AI button in Chats
column2: Masquer le bouton Meta AI dans Discussions

column1: # context: summary of that switch; your chats with Meta AI are conversations with the assistant, which stay in the list
Removes the Meta AI button beside the search box in Chats, at the top of the list and on the search screen. The search box stays, and so do your chats with Meta AI.
column2: Retire le bouton Meta AI à côté de la zone de recherche dans Discussions, en haut de la liste et sur l'écran de recherche. La zone de recherche reste, ainsi que vos discussions avec Meta AI.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; on, Facebook's Messenger icon opens the Messenger app
Open the Messenger app
column2: Ouvrir l'appli Messenger

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Messenger is the app's name, Chats is Facebook's own chat screen as named above
Tapping the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook opens the Messenger app instead of Chats. Without Messenger, Chats opens as before.
column2: Toucher l'icône Messenger en haut de Facebook ouvre l'appli Messenger au lieu de Discussions. Sans Messenger, Discussions s'ouvre comme avant.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; on, Facebook leaves ringing for calls and notifying about chats to the Messenger app
Leave calls and chats to Messenger
column2: Laisser les appels et discussions à Messenger

column1: # context: summary of that switch; signed out means not logged in to the Messenger app, turned off means the app is disabled in Android's settings

Facebook leaves calls and chat notifications to Messenger while Messenger is installed and enabled. Restart Facebook after changing this switch, or after installing, removing, enabling or disabling Messenger, so call routing updates. If you're signed out of Messenger, you'll miss calls and messages.
column2: Facebook laisse les appels et les notifications de discussion à Messenger tant que Messenger est installé et activé. Redémarrez Facebook après avoir changé cette option, ou après avoir installé, supprimé, activé ou désactivé Messenger, pour mettre à jour l'acheminement des appels. Si vous êtes déconnecté de Messenger, vous manquerez des appels et des messages.

column1: # context: settings section heading for the Tap to play switch
Playback
column2: Lecture

column1: # context: switch title; on, videos and music wait for a tap before they play
Tap to play
column2: Toucher pour lire

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Autoplay and Off are the name and value of Facebook's own setting, as Facebook shows them in this language
Videos, reels and music wait for your tap instead of playing by themselves. Facebook's own Autoplay setting shows Off while this is on.
column2: Les vidéos, les reels et la musique attendent que vous touchiez au lieu de se lancer tout seuls. Le réglage Lecture automatique de Facebook affiche Désactivée tant que cette option est activée.

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook; Marketplace is Facebook's tab and keeps its name
Marketplace only
column2: Marketplace uniquement

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook, next to Marketplace only; Events is Facebook's tab and keeps its name
Events only
column2: Évènements uniquement

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the tab names are Facebook's own, as its tab bar shows them
# context: switch title under Menu; Upgrades is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Upgrades
column2: Masquer Mises à niveau

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Settings and Help and support are Facebook's own Menu sections
The Upgrades section and its offers leave Facebook's Menu. Settings, Help and support and the rest of the Menu stay.
column2: La section Mises à niveau et ses offres quittent le Menu de Facebook. Paramètres, Aide et assistance et le reste du Menu restent.

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Also from Meta is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Also from Meta
column2: Masquer Aussi de Meta

column1: Hide the Muse card
column2: Masquer la carte Muse

column1: The Muse card, Meta's ad for its AI agent app, leaves the top of Facebook's Menu.
column2: La carte Muse, la pub de Meta pour son appli d'agent IA, quitte le haut du Menu de Facebook.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the section links to Meta's other apps and shows ads for its devices
The Also from Meta section leaves Facebook's Menu, with its links to Meta's other apps and its ads for Meta's devices. Your own shortcuts stay.
column2: La section Aussi de Meta quitte le Menu de Facebook, avec ses liens vers les autres applis de Meta et ses pubs pour les appareils Meta. Vos propres raccourcis restent.

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Help and support is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Help and support
column2: Masquer Aide et assistance

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Settings and privacy is Facebook's own Menu section
The Help and support section leaves Facebook's Menu, header and all. Settings and privacy stays.
column2: La section Aide et assistance quitte le Menu de Facebook, en-tête compris. Paramètres et confidentialité reste.

column1: Hide Your shortcuts
column2: Masquer Vos raccourcis

column1: The Your shortcuts row leaves Facebook's Menu, with the groups and Pages Facebook keeps putting back in it. The Menu tiles under it stay.
column2: La ligne Vos raccourcis quitte le Menu de Facebook, avec les groupes et les Pages que Facebook n'arrête pas d'y remettre. Les vignettes du Menu en dessous restent.

column1: Hide Create Facebook Page
column2: Masquer Créer une Page Facebook

column1: The Create Facebook Page row leaves the top of Facebook's Menu. Your profile above it stays.
column2: La ligne Créer une Page Facebook quitte le haut du Menu de Facebook. Votre profil au-dessus reste.

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Settings and privacy is a section of Facebook's own Menu that folds and unfolds when its header is tapped
Keep Settings and privacy expanded
column2: Garder Paramètres et confidentialité déplié

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu stays open, so its rows show without a tap.
column2: Paramètres et confidentialité reste déplié dans le Menu de Facebook, et ses lignes s'affichent sans toucher.

column1: # context: section title for the search settings, named like Facebook's own search
Search
column2: Recherche

column1: # context: switch title under Search; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name
Hide Meta AI in search
column2: Masquer Meta AI dans la recherche

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Meta AI and Ask Meta AI are Meta's own names, as Facebook shows them
Search no longer shows Meta AI answers or Ask Meta AI prompts, or sends your search to Meta AI. Results for people, groups, pages and posts stay.
column2: La recherche n'affiche plus les réponses de Meta AI ni les invitations Demander à Meta AI, et n'envoie plus vos recherches à Meta AI. Les résultats pour les personnes, groupes, pages et publications restent.

column1: # context: settings section heading for the Default comment order switch and its list
# context: switch title; on, a post's comments open in the order chosen in the list below it
Default comment order
column2: Ordre des commentaires par défaut

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a link to a comment is one from a notification, say
Use the order below. A choice made on a post lasts until restart. Links to comments keep Facebook's order.
column2: Utiliser l'ordre ci-dessous. Un choix fait sur une publication dure jusqu'au redémarrage. Les liens vers des commentaires gardent l'ordre de Facebook.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; Meta AI writes a short summary of what a post's comments say
Hide Meta AI comment summaries
column2: Masquer les résumés de commentaires de Meta AI

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the buttons are a post's Like, Comment and Share row
Hides Meta AI's summary at the top of comments and the comment summary under a post's buttons. The comments themselves stay.
column2: Masque le résumé de Meta AI en haut des commentaires et le résumé des commentaires sous les boutons d'une publication. Les commentaires eux-mêmes restent.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; the few comments Facebook shows under a post in the feed, below its Like, Comment and Share row
Hide comments under posts
column2: Masquer les commentaires sous les publications

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Comment is the post's Comment button
Feed posts stop showing a few comments under their buttons. Tap Comment to read them all.
column2: Les publications du fil n'affichent plus quelques commentaires sous leurs boutons. Touchez Commenter pour tous les lire.

column1: Hide dislike on comments
column2: Masquer Je n'aime pas sur les commentaires

column1: Takes the thumbs-down off comments. Like and Reply stay.
column2: Retire le pouce vers le bas des commentaires. J'aime et Répondre restent.

column1: Hide Like on comments
column2: Masquer J'aime sur les commentaires

column1: Takes Like off the row under comments. Reply and the reaction count stay.
column2: Retire J'aime de la ligne sous les commentaires. Répondre et le nombre de réactions restent.

column1: Hide Reply on comments
column2: Masquer Répondre sur les commentaires

column1: Takes Reply off the row under comments. View replies, Like and the reaction count stay.
column2: Retire Répondre de la ligne sous les commentaires. Voir les réponses, J'aime et le nombre de réactions restent.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments and writing, right under Hide Reply on comments; on, the small badges Facebook puts by a commenter's name (Top fan, Subscriber, group roles) go away; use Facebook's own name for the Top fan badge in your language
Hide badges like Top fan on comments
column2: Masquer les badges comme Fan assidu sur les commentaires

column1: # context: description of that switch; "Top fan" and "Subscriber" are Facebook's badge names, use Facebook's wording in your language; only the badge goes, the commenter's name and comment stay
Takes Top fan, Subscriber and the other badges off commenters' names. The name and the comment stay.
column2: Retire Fan assidu, Abonné et les autres badges des noms des commentateurs. Le nom et le commentaire restent.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; Like is the button under a post or a comment
Like only
column2: J'aime uniquement

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the reactions are the row of Love, Haha, Wow and the rest that a long press on Like opens
A long press on Like doesn't open the reactions. A tap still likes.
column2: Un appui long sur J'aime n'ouvre pas les réactions. Un simple toucher met toujours J'aime.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; GIF and sticker are two buttons in the box where you type a comment
Hide GIF and sticker buttons
column2: Masquer les boutons GIF et autocollant

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the comment box is where you type a comment
The comment box loses its GIF and sticker buttons. Typing, photos and posting work as before.
column2: La zone de commentaire perd ses boutons GIF et autocollant. La saisie, les photos et la publication fonctionnent comme avant.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments: hides the Add a comment field at the bottom of the full-screen video viewer
Hide the video comment box
column2: Masquer la zone de commentaire des vidéos

column1: The Add a comment box under a full-screen video goes away. Comment boxes on posts stay.
column2: La zone Ajouter un commentaire sous une vidéo en plein écran disparaît. Les zones de commentaire des publications restent.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; the bar along the bottom of a live video holds its comment box and the reactions you tap to send
Hide the live video comment bar
column2: Masquer la barre de commentaires des vidéos en direct

column1: # context: description of that switch; the reactions are the Like, Love, Haha and other faces a tap sends to the live video
The comment box and the row of reactions along the bottom of a live video go away, so a stray tap can't send one. The live comments stay.
column2: La zone de commentaire et la rangée de réactions en bas d'une vidéo en direct disparaissent, pour qu'un toucher accidentel ne puisse pas en envoyer une. Les commentaires en direct restent.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; a reply thread is the replies under a comment, which Facebook folds behind View replies
Open every reply thread
column2: Ouvrir tous les fils de réponses

column1: # context: summary of that switch; View replies is the link Facebook shows under a comment that has replies
Comments show their replies right away, so there's no View replies to tap.
column2: Les commentaires affichent leurs réponses tout de suite, il n'y a donc plus de Voir les réponses à toucher.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; it makes an open reply thread load the rest of its replies by itself as the list is scrolled
Load whole reply threads
column2: Charger les fils de réponses en entier

column1: # context: summary of that switch; View more replies is the row Facebook shows under an open thread that has more replies to load
An open reply thread keeps loading as you scroll, so there's no View more replies to tap.
column2: Un fil de réponses ouvert continue de se charger pendant le défilement, il n'y a donc plus de Voir plus de réponses à toucher.

column1: Hide replies button
column2: Masquer le bouton des réponses

column1: An open reply thread gets a Hide replies button, so you can close it again after reading.
column2: Un fil de réponses ouvert reçoit un bouton Masquer les réponses, pour que vous puissiez le refermer après lecture.

column1: Hide replies
column2: Masquer les réponses

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; View more replies is the row under an open reply thread that loads more replies, and this makes the whole row take the tap instead of only its words
Tap anywhere on View more replies
column2: Toucher n'importe où sur Voir plus de réponses

column1: # context: summary of that switch
The whole View more replies row opens the replies, not just its words.
column2: Toute la ligne Voir plus de réponses ouvre les réponses, pas seulement son texte.

column1: Hide related groups
column2: Masquer les groupes associés

column1: A group post's comments end without the Related groups list and its Join buttons.
column2: Les commentaires d'une publication de groupe se terminent sans la liste Groupes associés et ses boutons Rejoindre.

column1: # context: row title under Comments that opens Facebook's own settings; reaction counts are the numbers next to the reactions on a post
Hide reaction counts
column2: Masquer le nombre de réactions

column1: # context: summary of that row; Preferences and Reaction preferences are the names Facebook's own settings use
Facebook has its own setting for this. Open Facebook's settings, then Preferences and Reaction preferences.
column2: Facebook a son propre réglage pour cela. Ouvrez les paramètres de Facebook, puis Préférences et Préférences de réaction.

column1: # context: message shown when Facebook's own settings could not be opened from that row
Facebook's settings didn't open. You'll find Reaction preferences in its Settings, under Preferences.
column2: Les paramètres de Facebook ne se sont pas ouverts. Vous trouverez Préférences de réaction dans ses Paramètres, sous Préférences.

column1: # context: title of the list of comment orders, and of its dialog
Comment order
column2: Ordre des commentaires

column1: # context: entry of that list: the order Facebook's servers pick, which is what happens without Hushfacebook
Facebook's choice
column2: Choix de Facebook

column1: # context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
Most relevant
column2: Les plus pertinents

column1: # context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
Newest
column2: Les plus récents

column1: # context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
All comments
column2: Tous les commentaires

column1: # context: summary of the list when Facebook's choice is picked; Most relevant is Facebook's own name for that order
Comments open in the order Facebook picks, which is usually Most relevant.
column2: Les commentaires s'ouvrent dans l'ordre choisi par Facebook, généralement Les plus pertinents.

column1: # context: summary of the list; %1$s is one of the order names above, as Facebook's sort menu shows it
A post's comments open with %1$s picked in their sort menu, where the post offers it.
column2: Les commentaires d'une publication s'ouvrent avec %1$s choisi dans leur menu de tri, quand la publication le propose.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that sets the comment order to Facebook's choice
Comments will open in the order Facebook picks.
column2: Les commentaires s'ouvriront dans l'ordre choisi par Facebook.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that sets the comment order; %1$s is one of the order names above
Comments will open with %1$s picked in their sort menu.
column2: Les commentaires s'ouvriront avec %1$s choisi dans leur menu de tri.

column1: # context: switch title under Search; the ads Facebook puts between search results
Hide sponsored search results
column2: Masquer les résultats de recherche sponsorisés

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Hides ads between your search results. The results you searched for stay.
column2: Masque les pubs entre vos résultats de recherche. Les résultats que vous avez cherchés restent.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the ads between the posts on a person's profile or a Page
Hide sponsored profile posts
column2: Masquer les publications sponsorisées des profils

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Page is Facebook's name for a business or public figure's page
Hides ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page. Their own posts stay.
column2: Masque les pubs entre les publications sur le profil de quelqu'un ou sur une Page. Ses propres publications restent.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; a note is the short text bubble (or a 'Drop a thought' prompt) Facebook shows over a person's profile picture
Hide profile notes
column2: Masquer les notes de profil

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Hides the note bubble that sits on profile pictures. Applies the next time you open a profile.
column2: Masque la bulle de note posée sur les photos de profil. S'applique la prochaine fois que vous ouvrez un profil.

column1: Hide the gift button on profiles
column2: Masquer le bouton cadeau sur les profils

column1: Takes the Send a gift button off other people's profiles. Applies the next time you open a profile.
column2: Retire le bouton pour envoyer un cadeau des profils des autres. S'applique la prochaine fois que vous ouvrez un profil.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Save is Facebook's own button that keeps a post in your saved items
Save button under posts
column2: Bouton Enregistrer sous les publications

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Like, Comment and Share are the buttons under a post
Adds Facebook's own Save button next to Like, Comment and Share under posts. A saved post shows its bookmark filled in.
column2: Ajoute le bouton Enregistrer de Facebook à côté de J'aime, Commenter et Partager sous les publications. Une publication enregistrée affiche son signet rempli.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; a button that saves a post's video or photos to the phone
Download button under posts
column2: Bouton Télécharger sous les publications

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Downloads is the name of Hushfacebook's settings page for saving media
Adds a Download button under posts with a video or photos. It saves the video, the photo, or every photo of an album, using the Downloads settings.
column2: Ajoute un bouton Télécharger sous les publications avec une vidéo ou des photos. Il enregistre la vidéo, la photo ou toutes les photos d'un album, selon les paramètres de Téléchargements.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Like is Facebook's own button under a post
Hide Like under posts
column2: Masquer J'aime sous les publications

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Comment is Facebook's own button under a post
Hide Comment under posts
column2: Masquer Commenter sous les publications

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Repost is Facebook's own button under a post, the two arrows between Comment and Share
Hide Repost under posts
column2: Masquer Republier sous les publications

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Share is Facebook's own button under a post
Hide Share under posts
column2: Masquer Partager sous les publications

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Send is Facebook's own button under a post that sends it in a chat
Hide Send under posts
column2: Masquer Envoyer sous les publications

column1: Hide Stars and gifts under posts
column2: Masquer Étoiles et cadeaux sous les publications

column1: Hide Save under posts
column2: Masquer Enregistrer sous les publications

column1: # context: summary shared by those five switches
Takes this button out of the row under posts in the feed. The other buttons stay, and a post with all of its buttons hidden shows no row.
column2: Retire ce bouton de la ligne sous les publications du fil. Les autres boutons restent, et une publication dont tous les boutons sont masqués n'affiche pas de ligne.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the buttons are Like, Comment, Share and the others in the row under a post
Ignore taps beside the buttons
column2: Ignorer les touches à côté des boutons

column1: # context: description of that switch; the reaction icons are the small stacked emoji at the end of that row, and who reacted is the list of people who reacted
A tap on the empty part of the row under a post, between the buttons and the reaction icons, does nothing instead of opening the comments or who reacted. The buttons work as before.
column2: Un toucher sur la partie vide de la ligne sous une publication, entre les boutons et les icônes de réaction, ne fait rien au lieu d'ouvrir les commentaires ou la liste des personnes qui ont réagi. Les boutons fonctionnent comme avant.

column1: # context: what stays in while Hushfacebook is paused, followed by the patch name in brackets; the row in Facebook's own Menu that opens Hushfacebook settings
# context: a short message when the Hushfacebook row in Facebook's Menu couldn't open the settings
Hushfacebook settings can't open here. Long-press the Facebook logo instead.
column2: Les paramètres Hushfacebook ne peuvent pas s'ouvrir ici. Faites plutôt un appui long sur le logo Facebook.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the row of groups Facebook suggests joining, shown between posts
Hide suggested groups
column2: Masquer les groupes suggérés

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Discover more groups is the label of Facebook's own button under that row
Hides the row of groups to join between posts. Posts from groups you're in stay.
column2: Masque la rangée de groupes à rejoindre entre les publications. Les publications des groupes dont vous êtes membre restent.

column1: Hides the row of groups to join between posts and the groups card between reels. Posts from groups you're in stay.
column2: Masque la rangée de groupes à rejoindre entre les publications et la carte de groupes entre les reels. Les publications des groupes dont vous êtes membre restent.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Facebook's own header of a row of Stories from people you don't know, shown between posts
Hide "Stories you might like"
column2: Masquer « Stories qui pourraient vous plaire »

column1: Hide Memories in the feed
column2: Masquer les souvenirs dans le fil

column1: Hide friend requests in the feed
column2: Masquer les demandes d'ami dans le fil

column1: Hide friends' locations
column2: Masquer la position des amis

column1: # context: switch title under News feed, part of Hide suggested and promoted posts; a post opened by tapping a notification
Hide more posts under notification posts
column2: Masquer les autres publications sous les publications de notification

column1: Hides Memories between posts, like "On this day" and friendship anniversaries. Your Memories page stays.
column2: Masque les souvenirs entre les publications, comme « Ce jour-là » et les anniversaires d'amitié. Votre page Souvenirs reste.

column1: Hides friend requests shown between posts. Your requests stay under Friends.
column2: Masque les demandes d'ami affichées entre les publications. Vos demandes restent dans Amis.

column1: Hides the card between posts that shows where your friends are.
column2: Masque la carte entre les publications qui montre où sont vos amis.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "More from your friends" is the heading Facebook shows over that list
A post you open from a notification ends without the "More from your friends" list Facebook adds under it, which can carry ads.
column2: Une publication ouverte depuis une notification se termine sans la liste « Plus de publications de vos amis » que Facebook ajoute en dessous, qui peut contenir des pubs.

column1: Hide the Find friends card
column2: Masquer la carte Retrouver des amis

column1: Hides the "Want to see more posts from friends?" card with its Find friends button where your friends' posts run out.
column2: Masque la carte « Vous voulez voir plus de publications d'amis ? » avec son bouton Retrouver des amis, là où les publications de vos amis s'épuisent.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the Stories tray is the row of Stories at the top of the feed
Hides the row of Stories from people you aren't connected to, between posts. Your friends' Stories and the Stories tray stay.
column2: Masque la rangée de stories de personnes avec qui vous n'êtes pas en lien, entre les publications. Les stories de vos amis et la barre des stories restent.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; trending videos Facebook sends as push notifications
Block trending video notifications
column2: Bloquer les notifications de vidéos tendance

column1: # context: summary of that switch; reels are Facebook's short videos
Trending videos and the reels Facebook picked for you stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: Les vidéos tendance et les reels que Facebook a choisis pour vous n'apparaissent plus dans vos notifications.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; memories are Facebook's posts from past years on the same day
Block memory notifications
column2: Bloquer les notifications de souvenirs

column1: # context: summary of that switch; On this day is the name Facebook gives its memories feature
Facebook's "On this day" memories stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: Les souvenirs « Ce jour-là » de Facebook n'apparaissent plus dans vos notifications.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; reminders of friends' birthdays
Block birthday notifications
column2: Bloquer les notifications d'anniversaire

column1: # context: summary of that switch
No more reminders that it's a friend's birthday.
column2: Plus de rappels pour l'anniversaire d'un ami.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; Page is Facebook's name for a business or public figure's page
Block group and Page highlights
column2: Bloquer les temps forts des groupes et des Pages

column1: # context: summary of that switch; creators are the people and Pages who post videos and posts you follow
Digests of what's going on in groups, Pages and creators you follow stop. Comments, replies and mentions still come through.
column2: Les résumés de ce qui se passe dans les groupes, les Pages et chez les créateurs que vous suivez s'arrêtent. Les commentaires, réponses et mentions arrivent toujours.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; People you may know is Facebook's name for its friend suggestions, as in Hide "People you may know"
Block "People you may know"
column2: Bloquer « Vous connaissez peut-être »

column1: # context: summary of that switch; friend requests are other notifications, which always come through
Friend suggestions stop showing up in your notifications. Friend requests still come through.
column2: Les suggestions d'amis n'apparaissent plus dans vos notifications. Les demandes d'ami arrivent toujours.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; places near you and weather alerts Facebook sends
Block nearby and weather notifications
column2: Bloquer les notifications de proximité et de météo

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Alerts about places near you and about the weather stop.
column2: Les alertes sur les lieux près de vous et sur la météo s'arrêtent.

column1: Block account setup reminders
column2: Bloquer les rappels de configuration du compte

column1: Reminders to finish setting up a Facebook account stop. Login and security alerts still come through.
column2: Les rappels pour terminer la configuration d'un compte Facebook s'arrêtent. Les alertes de connexion et de sécurité arrivent toujours.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; group activity is the notifications about new posts and activity in groups you're in
Block group activity notifications
column2: Bloquer les notifications d'activité des groupes

column1: # context: summary of the group activity switch
Notifications about new activity in your groups stop. Comments, replies and mentions in groups still come through.
column2: Les notifications sur la nouvelle activité dans vos groupes s'arrêtent. Les commentaires, réponses et mentions dans les groupes arrivent toujours.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; an event invite is someone inviting you to a Facebook event
Block event invites
column2: Bloquer les invitations aux évènements

column1: # context: summary of the event invites switch
Invites to events stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: Les invitations aux évènements n'apparaissent plus dans vos notifications.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; a live video is a broadcast someone is streaming right now
Block live video notifications
column2: Bloquer les notifications de vidéos en direct

column1: # context: summary of the live video switch; the ones you asked Facebook for are live notifications you turned on for a person or Page
Notifications that someone is live stop, including the ones you asked Facebook for.
column2: Les notifications indiquant que quelqu'un est en direct s'arrêtent, y compris celles que vous avez demandées à Facebook.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; reactions are likes and the other reaction buttons on posts and comments
Block reaction notifications
column2: Bloquer les notifications de réactions

column1: # context: summary of the reactions switch
Likes and reactions to your posts and comments stop showing up in your notifications. Comments still come through.
column2: Les J'aime et les réactions à vos publications et commentaires n'apparaissent plus dans vos notifications. Les commentaires arrivent toujours.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; quiet hours is a stretch of the day when the picked notification kinds are blocked
Quiet hours
column2: Heures calmes

column1: # context: summary of the quiet hours switch; the switches above are the notification switches, the two times below are the start and end rows
The switches above block their kinds only between the two times below. The rest of the day those kinds come through.
column2: Les options ci-dessus ne bloquent leurs types qu'entre les deux heures ci-dessous. Le reste de la journée, ces types passent.

column1: # context: row title and list title; the time quiet hours begin
Quiet hours start
column2: Début des heures calmes

column1: # context: row title and list title; the time quiet hours finish
Quiet hours end
column2: Fin des heures calmes

column1: # context: title of a note under Notifications, below the switches; what no switch there blocks
What always comes through
column2: Ce qui passe toujours

column1: # context: text of that note; Android's own settings are the phone's per-app notification categories, which Facebook's server defines
Messages, friend requests, comments, mentions, calls, login alerts and any kind not listed above always arrive. Android's notification settings for Facebook can block more.
column2: Les messages, demandes d'ami, commentaires, mentions, appels, alertes de connexion et tout type non listé ci-dessus arrivent toujours. Les paramètres de notification d'Android pour Facebook peuvent en bloquer davantage.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; the stories Facebook suggests in the Stories tray from accounts you don't follow
Hide suggested stories
column2: Masquer les stories suggérées

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Suggested is the label Facebook shows under such a story in the tray, and the tray reloads on its own schedule
Shows only friends and followed Pages in the Stories tray. Applies when Facebook next loads the tray.
column2: N'affiche que les amis et les Pages suivies dans la barre des stories. S'applique au prochain chargement de la barre par Facebook.

column1: # context: switch title under Marketplace; the ads Facebook puts between the things people sell in Marketplace's feed
Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
column2: Masquer les annonces sponsorisées de Marketplace

column1: Block Instant Games ads
column2: Bloquer les pubs des Jeux instantanés

column1: Games you play in Facebook show no ads. A game that asks for one is told there's none, so rewarded ads give no reward.
column2: Les jeux auxquels vous jouez dans Facebook n'affichent pas de pubs. Un jeu qui en demande une apprend qu'il n'y en a pas, donc les pubs récompensées ne donnent aucune récompense.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a boosted listing is one its seller paid Facebook to show to more people
Hides ads and boosted listings in Marketplace's feed and search results. Regular listings stay.
column2: Masque les pubs et les annonces boostées dans le fil et les résultats de recherche de Marketplace. Les annonces normales restent.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; hides posts whose text holds a word or phrase the person listed
Hide posts with words you choose
column2: Masquer les publications contenant vos mots

column1: Hide posts from people, Pages and sites
column2: Masquer les publications de personnes, Pages et sites

column1: Hides posts by people or Pages on your list below, posted in a group on it, or linking to sites on it, including shares. Your list stays on this phone unless you export it.
column2: Masque les publications des personnes ou Pages de votre liste ci-dessous, celles publiées dans un groupe de la liste ou contenant un lien vers un site de la liste, partages compris. Votre liste reste sur ce téléphone, sauf si vous l'exportez.

column1: People, Pages and sites to hide
column2: Personnes, Pages et sites à masquer

column1: One per line, up to %1$d: a name as Facebook shows it (a person, Page or group), a profile, Page or group ID, or a site like example.com, which also covers addresses like m.example.com. Capital letters don't matter. A Facebook link works when it has the ID in it.
column2: Un par ligne, jusqu'à %1$d : un nom tel que Facebook l'affiche (une personne, une Page ou un groupe), l'ID d'un profil, d'une Page ou d'un groupe, ou un site comme example.com, qui couvre aussi les adresses comme m.example.com. Les majuscules n'ont pas d'importance. Un lien Facebook fonctionne s'il contient l'ID.

column1: One name, ID or site per line
column2: Un nom, ID ou site par ligne

column1: Nobody listed yet, so no post is hidden.
column2: Personne dans la liste pour l'instant, aucune publication n'est donc masquée.

column1: %1$d person, Page or site.
column2: %1$d personne, Page ou site.

column1: %1$d people, Pages or sites.
column2: %1$d personnes, Pages ou sites.

column1: Your list of people, Pages and sites to hide will be empty.
column2: Votre liste de personnes, Pages et sites à masquer sera vide.

column1: Your list of people, Pages and sites to hide will hold %1$d entry.
column2: Votre liste de personnes, Pages et sites à masquer contiendra %1$d élément.

column1: Your list of people, Pages and sites to hide will hold %1$d entries.
column2: Votre liste de personnes, Pages et sites à masquer contiendra %1$d éléments.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the keep list is the second list under it, and a settings file is the one Export settings writes

Hides posts containing a word or phrase from your list below. Words that keep a post win over it. Your words stay on this phone unless you export them. Posts on profiles, Pages and in groups go too, and Reels tab reels go by their captions.
column2: Masque les publications contenant un mot ou une expression de votre liste ci-dessous. La liste Mots qui gardent une publication l'emporte sur celle-ci. Vos mots restent sur ce téléphone, sauf si vous les exportez. Les publications sur les profils, les Pages et dans les groupes disparaissent aussi, et les reels de l'onglet Reels selon leurs légendes.

column1: # context: title of the row and dialog holding the list of words and phrases that hide a post
Words to hide
column2: Mots à masquer

column1: # context: title of the row and dialog holding the list of words and phrases that keep a post even when it has a word to hide
Words that keep a post
column2: Mots qui gardent une publication

column1: # context: message of the Words to hide dialog; %1$d is how many phrases a list holds (50), %2$d and %3$d the shortest and longest phrase in characters (2 and 60)

One word or phrase per line, up to %1$d lines, each %2$d to %3$d characters long. A single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough on its own. Capital letters don't matter, and a phrase matches anywhere in a post's text, even inside longer words.
column2: Un mot ou une expression par ligne, jusqu'à %1$d lignes, de %2$d à %3$d caractères chacun. Un seul emoji ou un seul caractère chinois, japonais ou coréen suffit. Les majuscules n'ont pas d'importance, et une expression est trouvée n'importe où dans le texte d'une publication, même à l'intérieur de mots plus longs.

column1: # context: message of the Words that keep a post dialog; %1$d is how many phrases a list holds (50), %2$d and %3$d the shortest and longest phrase in characters (2 and 60)

A post with any of these stays, even when it also has a word to hide. One per line, up to %1$d lines, each %2$d to %3$d characters long. A single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough on its own.
column2: Une publication contenant l'un de ces mots reste, même si elle contient aussi un mot à masquer. Un par ligne, jusqu'à %1$d lignes, de %2$d à %3$d caractères chacun. Un seul emoji ou un seul caractère chinois, japonais ou coréen suffit.

column1: # context: hint in the empty text box of both word list dialogs
One word or phrase per line
column2: Un mot ou une expression par ligne

column1: # context: toast after saving a word list, one line left out; %2$d and %3$d are the shortest and longest phrase in characters
%1$d line was left out. A phrase needs %2$d to %3$d characters, but a single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough. One given twice counts once.
column2: %1$d ligne a été ignorée. Une expression doit faire de %2$d à %3$d caractères, mais un seul emoji ou un seul caractère chinois, japonais ou coréen suffit. Une expression saisie deux fois compte une seule fois.

column1: # context: toast after saving a word list, several lines left out; %2$d and %3$d are the shortest and longest phrase in characters
%1$d lines were left out. A phrase needs %2$d to %3$d characters, but a single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough. One given twice counts once.
column2: %1$d lignes ont été ignorées. Une expression doit faire de %2$d à %3$d caractères, mais un seul emoji ou un seul caractère chinois, japonais ou coréen suffit. Une expression saisie deux fois compte une seule fois.

column1: # context: summary of the Words to hide row while it's empty
No words yet, so no post is hidden.
column2: Aucun mot pour l'instant, aucune publication n'est donc masquée.

column1: # context: summary of the Words that keep a post row while it's empty
No words yet.
column2: Aucun mot pour l'instant.

column1: # context: summary of a word list row holding one phrase
%1$d word or phrase.
column2: %1$d mot ou expression.

column1: # context: summary of a word list row holding several phrases
%1$d words or phrases.
column2: %1$d mots ou expressions.

column1: # context: line under a word list being edited: how full the room both lists share would be; %1$d is a whole percent
Both lists together fill %1$d%% of the room they share.
column2: Ensemble, les deux listes occupent %1$d%% de la place qu'elles partagent.

column1: # context: under a word list being edited, and when its Save is refused: more phrases than a list holds; %1$d is the most a list holds
A list holds up to %1$d phrases, and this one has more. Remove some, then save again.
column2: Une liste contient jusqu'à %1$d expressions, et celle-ci en a plus. Retirez-en quelques-unes, puis enregistrez à nouveau.

column1: # context: under a word list being edited, and when its Save is refused: both lists would take more than the room they share; %1$d is a whole percent past 100
Both lists together would fill %1$d%% of the room they share. Remove or shorten some phrases, then save again.
column2: Ensemble, les deux listes occuperaient %1$d%% de la place qu'elles partagent. Retirez ou raccourcissez quelques expressions, puis enregistrez à nouveau.

column1: # context: added to the Words to hide summary: posts the filter hid since Facebook last started, one
Hid %1$d post since Facebook started.
column2: %1$d publication masquée depuis le démarrage de Facebook.

column1: # context: added to the Words to hide summary: posts the filter hid since Facebook last started, several
Hid %1$d posts since Facebook started.
column2: %1$d publications masquées depuis le démarrage de Facebook.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that empties the list of words to hide
Your list of words to hide will be empty.
column2: Votre liste de mots à masquer sera vide.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import; the list of words to hide will hold one phrase
Your list of words to hide will hold %1$d word or phrase.
column2: Votre liste de mots à masquer contiendra %1$d mot ou expression.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import; the list of words to hide will hold several phrases
Your list of words to hide will hold %1$d words or phrases.
column2: Votre liste de mots à masquer contiendra %1$d mots ou expressions.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that empties the keep list
Your list of words that keep a post will be empty.
column2: Votre liste de mots qui gardent une publication sera vide.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import; the keep list will hold one phrase
Your list of words that keep a post will hold %1$d word or phrase.
column2: Votre liste de mots qui gardent une publication contiendra %1$d mot ou expression.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import; the keep list will hold several phrases
Your list of words that keep a post will hold %1$d words or phrases.
column2: Votre liste de mots qui gardent une publication contiendra %1$d mots ou expressions.

column1: # context: section title for the settings about writing posts and comments
Writing
column2: Écriture

column1: # context: switch title under Writing; @ is the at sign that starts a mention and stays as it is
Tag suggestions only after @
column2: Suggestions d'identification seulement après @

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the list is Facebook's list of people to tag, and @ stays as it is
Type @ before Facebook suggests someone to tag in posts or comments. Your text stays unchanged.
column2: Tapez @ pour que Facebook vous suggère quelqu'un à identifier dans les publications ou les commentaires. Votre texte reste inchangé.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; on, a long video you left partway starts again where you left it
Resume long videos
column2: Reprendre les longues vidéos

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the seek bar is the bar under a video you drag to move through it; Reels is Facebook's name for its short videos
Videos over two minutes pick up where you left off. Drag the bar to start elsewhere. Short reels, live videos and ads start as usual.
column2: Les vidéos de plus de deux minutes reprennent là où vous vous êtes arrêté. Faites glisser la barre pour commencer ailleurs. Les reels courts, les vidéos en direct et les pubs démarrent normalement.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; a frame is one still picture of a video
Frame step
column2: Image par image

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Reels is Facebook's name for its short videos
With a reel or video paused, tap its right side to step one frame forward and its left side to step one frame back. Tap the middle to play.
column2: Quand un reel ou une vidéo est en pause, touchez le côté droit pour avancer d'une image et le côté gauche pour reculer d'une image. Touchez le milieu pour lire.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed, right below Hide AI-detected posts; on, posts their creator labelled as AI go too
Also hide posts labeled as AI
column2: Masquer aussi les publications étiquetées IA

column1: Hide Meta AI in the feed
column2: Masquer Meta AI dans le fil

column1: Hides Meta AI cards between posts and cards promoting the Vibes app. People's posts stay, whatever they say about AI.
column2: Masque les cartes Meta AI entre les publications et les cartes qui font la promotion de l'appli Vibes. Les publications des gens restent, quoi qu'elles disent sur l'IA.

column1: Hide AI character posts
column2: Masquer les publications de personnages IA

column1: Hides posts featuring Meta's AI characters, the chatbots people make with Meta AI Studio. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real feed yet.
column2: Masque les publications montrant les personnages IA de Meta, les chatbots que les gens créent avec Meta AI Studio. Désactivée par défaut, car l'option n'a pas encore été testée sur un vrai fil.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the AI label is the one Facebook shows next to the poster's name on such posts
Also hides posts their creator labeled as made with AI, not just the ones Facebook detects itself. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real feed yet.
column2: Masque aussi les publications que leur créateur a étiquetées comme faites avec l'IA, pas seulement celles que Facebook détecte lui-même. Désactivé par défaut, car pas encore testé sur un vrai fil.

column1: Return to regular Facebook
column2: Revenir au Facebook normal

column1: Restore the normal tabs at the next restart. Your other settings stay saved.
column2: Rétablit les onglets normaux au prochain redémarrage. Vos autres paramètres restent enregistrés.

column1: Marketplace only and Events only are off. Restart Facebook to restore its normal tabs.
column2: Marketplace uniquement et Évènements uniquement sont désactivés. Redémarrez Facebook pour rétablir ses onglets normaux.

column1: Couldn't save the change. Try again.
column2: Impossible d'enregistrer le changement. Réessayez.

column1: Marketplace only chooses the opening tab. Your previous choice stays saved.
column2: Marketplace uniquement choisit l'onglet d'ouverture. Votre choix précédent reste enregistré.

column1: # context: summary of the tab rows under Opening Facebook while Events only is on
Events only chooses the opening tab. Your previous choice stays saved.
column2: Évènements uniquement choisit l'onglet d'ouverture. Votre choix précédent reste enregistré.

column1: Restart needed. Marketplace only will turn on the next time Facebook starts.
column2: Redémarrage nécessaire. Marketplace uniquement s'activera au prochain démarrage de Facebook.

column1: # context: status line under the Events only switch
Restart needed. Events only will turn on the next time Facebook starts.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; Android's own name for the floating video window
Picture-in-picture
column2: Picture-in-picture

column1: # context: summary of that switch
A playing reel or full-screen video keeps going in a small window when you leave Facebook. Android 12 or later.
column2: Un reel en lecture ou une vidéo en plein écran continue dans une petite fenêtre quand vous quittez Facebook. Android 12 ou version ultérieure.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; HDR is the high-contrast video and photo format some screens show brighter than everything else
Turn off HDR brightness
column2: Désactiver la luminosité HDR

column1: # context: summary of that switch
HDR videos and photos stay at your screen's usual brightness instead of turning it up to full. They keep their resolution.
column2: Les vidéos et photos HDR restent à la luminosité habituelle de votre écran au lieu de la pousser au maximum. Elles gardent leur résolution.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback, below Turn off HDR brightness; when a video comes in both HDR and SDR, the SDR copy plays. Keep HDR and SDR as they are
Play SDR versions of HDR videos
column2: Lire les versions SDR des vidéos HDR

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "the same size" means the same resolution; "the switch above" is Turn off HDR brightness
When Facebook also sends an HDR video in SDR at the same size, play that version instead. The screen doesn't brighten and the picture stays as sharp. Works with the switch above on or off.
column2: Quand Facebook envoie aussi une vidéo HDR en SDR à la même résolution, c'est cette version qui est lue. L'écran ne s'éclaircit pas et l'image reste aussi nette. Fonctionne avec l'option ci-dessus activée ou non.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; it makes videos play past the silent stretches of their sound
Skip silent parts
column2: Sauter les passages silencieux

column1: # context: summary of that switch; how-tos are tutorial videos
Videos, reels and stories jump past the quiet stretches in their sound, so talks and how-tos get to the point sooner.
column2: Les vidéos, reels et stories sautent les passages silencieux de leur son, pour que les discours et les tutoriels aillent plus vite à l'essentiel.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; feed videos stay silent until the user turns their sound on
Keep feed videos muted
column2: Garder les vidéos du fil en sourdine

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the speaker is the sound button on a video, volume up is the phone's key
Videos in your feed start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, and only you turn it on. Tap a video's speaker or press volume up to hear it.
column2: Les vidéos du fil démarrent sans le son chaque fois que vous ouvrez Facebook, et vous seul activez le son. Touchez le bouton du son d'une vidéo ou appuyez sur volume + pour l'entendre.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; keeps a video's progress bar (the line showing how far it has played) on screen
Keep the progress bar
column2: Garder la barre de progression

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a reel is a short vertical video
A reel's progress bar stays full size, ready to drag. A full-screen video's controls stay until you tap.
column2: La barre de progression d'un reel reste en grand, prête à être glissée. Les commandes d'une vidéo en plein écran restent jusqu'à ce que vous touchiez l'écran.

column1: Show a reel's time
column2: Afficher la durée d'un reel

column1: With Keep the progress bar on, a reel's elapsed and total time stay above the bar. Off, they show only while you drag it.
column2: Avec Garder la barre de progression activé, le temps écoulé et la durée totale d'un reel restent au-dessus de la barre. Désactivé, ils n'apparaissent que pendant que vous la faites glisser.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; while you press a reel's progress bar, the poster's name and the like, comment and share buttons stay on screen
Keep the name and buttons while seeking
column2: Garder le nom et les boutons en parcourant la vidéo

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the caption is the text under a reel
Pressing a reel's progress bar leaves the name, caption and buttons on screen. Off, Facebook clears them until you let go.
column2: Appuyer sur la barre de progression d'un reel laisse le nom, la légende et les boutons à l'écran. Désactivé, Facebook les retire jusqu'à ce que vous relâchiez.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback, after Show a reel's time; a tap on the video's progress bar jumps to that point
Tap the bar to seek
column2: Toucher la barre pour avancer

column1: # context: description of that switch; the dot is the bar's round handle you drag
Tap anywhere on a reel's or video's progress bar to jump there, instead of dragging the dot.
column2: Touchez n'importe où sur la barre de progression d'un reel ou d'une vidéo pour y aller directement, au lieu de faire glisser le point.

column1: # context: switch title under Marketplace; View profile is Facebook's own button on a seller's Marketplace page that opens their regular Facebook profile, so use Facebook's label for it in this language
Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
column2: Afficher Voir le profil chez les vendeurs Marketplace

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Adds a View profile button to every seller's Marketplace page, opening their Facebook profile. Facebook only shows it to some accounts.
column2: Ajoute un bouton Voir le profil à la page Marketplace de chaque vendeur, qui ouvre son profil Facebook. Facebook ne l'affiche qu'à certains comptes.

column1: # context: switch title under Marketplace; a listing is one item for sale on Marketplace, and the gap is an empty band between the status bar and the listing's close and share buttons (#333)
Remove the gap above Marketplace listings
column2: Supprimer l'espace au-dessus des annonces Marketplace

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Pixel is Google's phone, keep the name
Takes out the empty band some phones show above a listing's top row, like Pixels on Android 17.
column2: Supprime la bande vide que certains téléphones affichent au-dessus de la première ligne d'une annonce, comme les Pixel sous Android 17.

column1: # context: the Save Facebook's notification sound row under Notifications and its toasts (#83)
Save Facebook's notification sound
column2: Enregistrer le son de notification de Facebook

column2: Ajoute le carillon de Facebook aux sons de notification du téléphone, pour les catégories réglées sur Aucun. Choisissez-le ensuite dans les paramètres de notification Android pour Facebook, sous Son.

Hide the composer row
column2: Masquer la zone de publication

column1: # context: summary of that switch; use the wording Facebook itself uses in this language for "What's on your mind?" and Home
Hides the "What's on your mind?" row at the top of Home. The create button in the top bar still starts a post.
column2: Masque la ligne « Que voulez-vous dire ? » en haut de l'Accueil. Le bouton de création de la barre du haut permet toujours de publier.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Clean mode is Facebook's own three-dot menu item on a reel or video that hides the buttons down the side, so use Facebook's name for it in this language (#75)
Always use Clean mode
column2: Toujours utiliser le mode épuré

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "the usual way" means Facebook's own way out of Clean mode
Opens reels and videos in Facebook's Clean mode, which hides the buttons down the side. You can still leave Clean mode as usual. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Ouvre les reels et vidéos dans le mode épuré de Facebook, qui masque les boutons sur le côté. Vous pouvez toujours quitter le mode épuré comme d'habitude. Désactivé par défaut, car pas encore testé sur un vrai compte.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, part of Clean up Reels; each reel plays to its end one time and stops there instead of starting over
Play reels once
column2: Lire les reels une seule fois

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "last frame" is the final picture of the video, which stays on screen

A reel stops on its last frame instead of starting over. Tap it to watch again, or swipe to the next one. Feed videos and stories aren't changed. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Un reel s'arrête sur sa dernière image au lieu de recommencer. Touchez-le pour le revoir, ou balayez vers le suivant. Les vidéos du fil et les stories ne changent pas. Désactivé par défaut, car pas encore testé sur un vrai compte.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, part of Clean up Reels; reels and videos play in the language they were recorded in instead of an audio track Facebook translated
Keep the original audio
column2: Garder l'audio d'origine

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "dubbed" means the spoken audio was replaced by a translated voice; Meta AI is the company's AI assistant, keep the name
Reels and videos play with the sound they were made with, not a version Facebook dubbed into your language with Meta AI. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Les reels et vidéos sont lus avec leur son d'origine, pas une version que Facebook a doublée dans votre langue avec Meta AI. Désactivé par défaut, car pas encore testé sur un vrai compte.

Meta's other products

Hide Edits promotions
column2: Masquer les promotions Edits

column1: # context: switch title; Threads is Meta's app, keep its name; cross-posting means sharing a Facebook post to Threads as well
Hide Threads cross-posting prompts
column2: Masquer les invitations à publier aussi sur Threads

Hide Threads in the share sheet
column2: Masquer Threads dans le menu de partage

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Muse is Meta's AI agent app, keep its name; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post, use Facebook's own word for it in this language
Hide Muse in the share sheet
column2: Masquer Muse dans le menu de partage

column1: # context: switch title; Meta Verified is Meta's paid subscription, keep its name
Hide Meta Verified offers
